name: three-ws-docs-retrieval
description: Hand-written retrieval questions against specific sections of the three.ws docs. Each question is paraphrased so it does not reuse the section's own wording, and names the section(s) that answer it as relevant. Every section of every corpus file is a candidate, so the other files act as distractors.
